Class PhoneIntervalsElementFilter

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.visitor.VisitorAdapter<TierElement>
ca.phon.session.alignment.PhoneIntervalsElementFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
TierElementFilter, Visitor<TierElement>
public class PhoneIntervalsElementFilter extends VisitorAdapter<TierElement> implements TierElementFilter
Filter for phone interval tiers. This filter is used to collect elements for cross-tier alignment.
